import pytest
from rich.style import Style
from rich.text import Text, Span


def test_assemble_meta_python_3_14_bug():
    """
    Test for issue #3740 where Style(meta=...) was not correctly compared
    due to a change in Python 3.14's handling of default arguments in __eq__.
    """
    text = Text.assemble("foo", ("bar", "bold"), meta={"foo": "bar"})
    assert str(text) == "foobar"
    # The original bug was that the Style object created internally for the
    # meta span was not considered equal to a manually constructed Style object
    # with the same meta, even though their attributes were identical.
    # This assertion should pass once the __eq__ method of Style is fixed
    # to correctly compare meta dictionaries.
    assert text._spans == [Span(3, 6, "bold"), Span(0, 6, Style(meta={"foo": "bar"}))]
